title: Document minimal normalized v1 trace examples
summary: Document the existing contract with synthetic examples; this is fixture/documentation work, not schema redesign.
acceptance: Provide importable message-only, successful-tool, and failed-tool examples.
Explain required fields and null-versus-omitted behavior.
Import each example in a test and assert stated counts.
validation: Run example tests and the full suite.

title: Add multilingual and escaped-newline import fixtures
summary: Cover text preservation in both supported formats without assuming existing corruption.
acceptance: Cover Arabic, CJK, emoji, combining characters, and escaped newlines.
Assert exact text and correct JSONL record counts.
Use invented data without real credentials or sessions.
validation: Run fixtures through both formats and the full suite.

title: Test interleaved tool calls with reverse-order results
summary: Extend existing ID correlation tests with overlapping calls to the same tool.
acceptance: Create three overlapping same-tool calls with distinct IDs.
Assert exact pairs with reverse-order results.
Verify an unknown result never completes an unrelated call.
validation: Ensure matching by proximity or name would fail the tests.

title: Test interrupted sessions and orphan results
summary: Cover incomplete recordings without fabricating completion; diagnostics are a separate proposal.
acceptance: Include a complete call, unmatched call, and orphan result.
Preserve events without invented output/completion times.
Explain that missing results do not prove a hang.
validation: Verify the orphan cannot complete the unmatched call.

title: Document and test supported JSONL framing variations
summary: Add regression coverage for existing BOM, LF, and CRLF behavior; do not change import policy.
acceptance: Test LF, CRLF, leading BOM, and no final newline.
Assert equivalent normalized events for accepted variants.
Keep malformed middle records as errors with correct lines.
validation: Run framing tests and compare policy with the importer.

title: Document the implemented Claude Code field mapping
summary: Map implemented fields with fixtures and explicit upstream version uncertainty.
acceptance: Map supported fields to destinations or omissions.
Reference message, call, and result fixtures.
State verified versions or mark synthetic unverified samples.
validation: Compare mapping with code and run the cited fixtures.

title: Cover blank input and metadata-only sessions
summary: Record current behavior for recordings without visible events; discuss policy changes separately.
acceptance: Cover whitespace, metadata-only records, and empty events.
Assert documented outcomes without relying on stack traces.
Verify no invented messages or calls appear.
validation: Run table-driven tests with an explanation for each outcome.

title: Index fixtures and their golden normalized outputs
summary: Track expected outputs; privacy provenance belongs to ABB-108.
acceptance: Map inputs to golden outputs or expected error patterns.
Reject missing files, duplicate paths, and unknown expectation types.
Run listed cases and compare outputs or documented error patterns.
validation: Show that changed events or missing outputs fail validation.

title: [Investigation] Specify a verified Codex log adapter
summary: Research a version-pinned recording format; deliver reviewed fixtures and mapping before implementation.
acceptance: Cite version, public references, and sample-generation steps.
Cover messages, calls, results, and interrupted recordings.
Specify detection, mapping, and unsupported cases.
validation: Review samples and reproduce collection without hosted services.

title: Implement the approved Codex session adapter
summary: Implement only the reviewed subset from ABB-009, with explicit version support.
acceptance: Normalize approved fixtures and correlate results.
Apply approved unknown-record policy and validate fields.
Reject unrelated JSONL with generic message fields.
validation: Run golden, negative, and existing adapter tests.

title: [Investigation] Define an offline OTLP JSON mapping
summary: Investigate real OTLP JSON and pinned GenAI conventions for a narrow offline adapter.
acceptance: Document exporter and semantic-convention versions.
Map IDs, parents, times, tools, and absent content.
Include multiple resources/scopes and content-free spans.
validation: Review against OTLP references without collector/network dependencies.

title: Implement the approved offline OTLP JSON adapter
summary: Import the reviewed subset as supplied data; do not build a collector.
acceptance: Traverse approved containers and preserve relationships.
Convert documented timestamps; leave absent content absent.
Reject unsupported encodings and avoid reclassifying normal spans.
validation: Run golden fixtures and verify no network requests.

title: [Investigation] Specify an OpenHands event adapter
summary: Research serialized events from a specific release before proposing support.
acceptance: Cite release, serialization references, and reproduction steps.
Provide action/observation fixtures with correlation IDs.
List omissions and reliable detection evidence.
validation: Trace each mapping to a cited version or fixture.

title: Implement the approved OpenHands event adapter
summary: Support the reviewed subset while distinguishing actions from observed results.
acceptance: Pair approved actions/results through documented IDs.
Preserve unmatched observations without invented success.
Document verified versions and reject incompatible input.
validation: Run complete, interrupted, unknown-event, and unrelated fixtures.

title: [Investigation] Define reproducible LangGraph capture
summary: Find a documented event interface; do not assume universal file exports.
acceptance: Pin version and cite the public capture API.
Provide local examples of tools, streams, and nested runs.
Explain chunk assembly and relationship identifiers.
validation: Reproduce capture without a paid tracing account.

title: Implement the approved LangGraph capture adapter
summary: Normalize the agreed format with explicit producer and capture semantics.
acceptance: Assemble chunks without duplicate final content.
Preserve documented tool pairs and available run relationships.
Apply agreed incomplete/unknown-event policies.
validation: Compare golden outputs and run existing tests.

title: Publish JSON Schema for normalized trace version 1
summary: Describe the current contract; review discrepancies before changing behavior.
acceptance: Declare dialect, top-level requirements, and event variants.
Add valid/invalid examples of types and required values.
Validate in development without new runtime dependencies.
validation: Validate fixtures and investigate importer disagreements.

title: [Investigation] Define schema compatibility rules
summary: Propose evolution rules; implementation follows an accepted decision.
acceptance: Specify unknown-version/event/field and missing-field policy.
Define version bumps and extension namespaces.
Provide old-reader/new-writer examples and a decision table.
validation: Review against v1 and record unresolved decisions.

title: Implement the approved schema compatibility policy
summary: Apply ABB-018 consistently with actionable errors.
acceptance: Test every accepted decision-table row.
Use stable errors for unsupported versions/required fields.
Handle unknown fields and event types exactly as specified.
validation: Run schema, compatibility, and future-version fixtures.

title: Preserve event identity and source provenance
summary: Discuss trace-scoped identities and locations, including combined source records, before coding.
acceptance: Define deterministic trace-scoped IDs without cross-session collisions.
Allow multiple source locations for assembled events.
Handle duplicate source IDs without copying raw payloads.
validation: Reimport for stable IDs and test separate trace namespaces.

title: Preserve high-resolution time and clock domains
summary: Discuss optional precision metadata under the evolution policy; current millisecond support is not presumed broken.
acceptance: Preserve adapter-provided precision and clock domain.
Convert nanoseconds without unsafe Number coercion.
Use compatible clocks for durations and ingestion order for ties.
validation: Test large integers, ties, missing times, and mixed clocks.

title: [Investigation] Specify nested and delegated runs
summary: Propose a hierarchy based on verified examples before changing correlation.
acceptance: Distinguish nested tool spans from delegated agents.
Define run-ID, parent, and invocation-ID scopes.
Specify missing parents, reused IDs, and cycles.
validation: Walk fixtures through the model and prevent cross-run matching.

title: Implement the approved nested-run model
summary: Implement hierarchy and normalization while retaining flat-trace compatibility.
acceptance: Normalize fixtures with run-scoped result pairing.
Preserve parentless children without inventing parents.
Handle cycles without infinite traversal.
validation: Run flat/nested fixtures with reused invocation IDs.

title: Preserve attachment descriptors in content
summary: Discuss metadata-only attachment fields; never fetch or decode referenced content.
acceptance: Define optional media type, declared size, and references.
Preserve neighboring text in mixed content.
Never fetch URLs, read referenced files, or decode media.
validation: Instrument mixed-content tests against network/filesystem reads.

title: Expose structured import warnings with stable codes
summary: Evolve warning strings through a reviewed backward-compatibility plan.
acceptance: Define code, severity, and source location fields.
Represent current warnings without changing acceptance policy.
Document and test compatibility for string consumers.
validation: Assert codes/locations and absence of synthetic secrets.

title: Add an incremental JSONL import API
summary: Discuss chunked import preserving limits without retaining the whole raw string.
acceptance: Handle splits inside UTF-8, strings, and separators.
Match whole-file output and source-line errors.
Enforce byte/event/depth limits without full buffering.
validation: Split fixtures at many byte positions and test oversized input.

title: Support cooperative cancellation of streaming imports
summary: Add AbortSignal to incremental core import; UI controls are separate.
acceptance: An already-aborted signal prevents iteration.
Mid-import abort stops reads and closes the iterator where possible.
Never report cancellation as success or leave owned reads pending.
validation: Use a controlled iterator to verify counts and cleanup.

title: Add opt-in duplicate-record handling
summary: Discuss source identity rather than content similarity as the basis for deduplication.
acceptance: Keep deduplication opt-in with documented eligible IDs.
Collapse identical identity/payload records and report counts.
Preserve distinct calls and surface conflicting reused IDs.
validation: Test duplicates, legitimate repeats, same-time events, and conflicts.

title: Merge explicitly ordered segments from one session
summary: Merge compatible segments using agreed identity/deduplication rules.
acceptance: Respect explicit order and retain segment provenance.
Handle overlaps with the approved duplicate policy.
Pair across segments and reject incompatible session identities.
validation: Compare split/whole traces, overlaps, reversed order, and mixed sessions.

title: Explain adapter detection and reject ambiguity
summary: Discuss format evidence rather than parser order or generic fields.
acceptance: Require documented evidence from every detector.
Return ambiguous candidates instead of silently selecting one.
Validate explicit format selection as well as auto-detection.
validation: Test current/unrelated/truncated input and matching detector stubs.

title: Add bounded windows to repeated-call diagnostics
summary: Separate local bursts from session-wide repetition with optional event/time windows.
acceptance: Define inclusive event/time window boundaries.
Detect clustered calls without grouping distant calls as a burst.
Document fallback for absent/incompatible clocks.
validation: Test thresholds, sparse calls, interleaving, and missing times.

title: Detect repeated multi-tool cycles with evidence
summary: Observe sequence cycles without claiming every repeated workflow is a failure.
acceptance: Bound motif length and define repetition threshold.
Attach exact event ranges with observed-cycle wording.
Bound work and avoid equivalent nested findings.
validation: Test short cycles, broken/normal workflows, and large inputs.

title: Group explicit repeated failures across arguments
summary: Use conservative failure signatures; successful output discussing errors must not count.
acceptance: Document signature and preserve invocation evidence/counts.
Group varying arguments with the same explicit failure.
Separate error types and exclude successful error examples.
validation: Test signatures, tool boundaries, and benign output.

title: Annotate observed recovery after failed attempts
summary: Link tool failures to later matching success without asserting overall task success.
acceptance: Match conservatively on tool and canonical arguments.
Link failures to later success without deleting evidence.
Leave unrelated success and incomplete recordings unresolved.
validation: Test fail/success, repeats, unrelated success, order, and cuts.

title: Report calls with no recorded result
summary: Identify unmatched invocations while preserving uncertainty about partial recordings.
acceptance: Use evidence-backed wording such as No result recorded.
Do not flag calls with results later in the trace.
Separate orphan results and document partial-trace severity.
validation: Run complete, interrupted, reordered, and orphan fixtures.

title: Build a labelled diagnostic evaluation corpus
summary: Measure false positives and missed findings alongside benign polling and retries.
acceptance: Annotate expected rule IDs, evidence, and no-finding cases.
Report true/false positives and false negatives per rule.
Include positive and benign cases for every measured rule.
validation: Show that added/removed findings change the evaluation counts.

title: Introduce a pure diagnostic-rule interface
summary: Discuss a rule contract; never load executable plugins from trace content.
acceptance: Define stable IDs and the evidence input/output contract.
Migrate repeated-call detection without changing defaults.
Test determinism and immutability with a sample rule.
validation: Compare existing fixtures and valid/malformed rule outputs.

title: Extract a minimal evidence slice for a finding
summary: Return evidence with bounded context and mark the trace partial; leave UI separate.
acceptance: Include referenced events and necessary existing call/result partners.
Preserve IDs and mark omitted context explicitly.
Honor context bounds without mutating the original.
validation: Test distant evidence, missing partners, limits, and reimport.

title: Support scoped diagnostic suppressions with reasons
summary: Discuss explicit rule/tool/run suppressions with visible audit metadata.
acceptance: Require exact rule IDs, valid scopes, and a reason.
Reject unknown IDs and malformed selectors.
Record suppressed findings/reasons without changing source events.
validation: Test global/scoped/nonmatching suppression and invalid config.

title: Attach structured evidence references to findings
summary: Discuss stable finding metadata distinguishing observation and inference without raw payload copies.
acceptance: Include rule ID, explanation, and supporting event IDs.
Document inference and uncertainty for incomplete recordings.
Validate targets and exclude raw argument/result payloads.
validation: Test repeat evidence, dangling references, and deterministic order.

title: Replace loaded sessions through drag-and-drop
summary: Extend drop import to loaded sessions and handle multiple dropped files explicitly.
acceptance: Replace a loaded session through existing parsing and redaction.
Keep the current session intact until replacement imports successfully.
Reject multiple files clearly and prevent browser navigation.
validation: Test replacement, parse failure, multiple files, and keyboard picker access.

title: Import a session from pasted transcript text
summary: Inspect copied JSONL or normalized JSON without creating a file.
acceptance: Parse pasted text with the existing parser and default redaction.
Keep invalid input editable and restore focus when the dialog closes.
Clear text after success or cancellation; never persist transcript contents.
validation: Exercise valid/invalid input, keyboard dialog use, redaction, and browser storage.

title: Toggle absolute and elapsed event timestamps
summary: Offer timestamp presentation choices without changing event order or exported data.
acceptance: Switch between absolute timestamps and elapsed time from the earliest valid event.
Show unavailable for missing times instead of invented elapsed values.
Preserve filters, selection, and exported timestamps when switching.
validation: Check valid, missing, invalid, and out-of-order timestamps in both modes.

title: Add removable active filter chips
summary: Make active search, tool, and error filters visible beside the timeline.
acceptance: Render a labeled removal button for each active filter.
Removing a chip changes only its filter and refreshes the event count.
Clear-all resets filters while preserving the session and valid selection.
validation: Combine filters, remove them in different orders, and inspect counts and focus.

title: Add discoverable viewer keyboard shortcuts
summary: Provide documented shortcuts for search, import, and returning to a selected event.
acceptance: Provide a help button and a dialog listing every shortcut.
Ignore editable fields and preserve browser-reserved shortcuts.
Support Escape and focus restoration when closing help.
validation: Check shortcuts from the timeline, editable fields, details, and help dialog.

title: Search within selected tool results
summary: Find text inside long sanitized outputs without changing timeline filters.
acceptance: Provide a details query, match count, and previous/next controls.
Highlight matches through safe DOM operations without interpreting HTML.
Reset match navigation on event changes; leave timeline filters unchanged.
validation: Check multiline matches, no matches, repeated text, hostile markup, and keyboard use.

title: Bookmark events during an investigation
summary: Add temporary bookmarks for important calls during the current review.
acceptance: Add, remove, and navigate bookmarks from an accessible list.
Keep identities stable across filtering and incremental rendering.
Remove bookmarks on session replacement or clear; do not persist them.
validation: Bookmark later-page events, filter, revisit, and replace the session.

title: Run browser imports in a cancellable worker
summary: Keep large imports responsive while preserving parsing and redaction.
acceptance: Return only sanitized session data from worker parsing.
Cancel an import without discarding the previous session.
Ignore stale worker responses after cancellation or replacement.
validation: Check large imports, cancellation, rapid replacements, errors, and unavailable workers.

title: Add line navigation to tool results
summary: Provide optional line numbers and jump-to-line navigation.
acceptance: Line numbers follow logical newlines and do not enter copied text.
Validate a labeled jump control and reveal the requested line.
Handle empty output, trailing newlines, and event changes consistently.
validation: Check multiline fixtures, trailing blanks, invalid line numbers, and copying.

title: Add a wrap-lines preference for tool details
summary: Choose wrapped or horizontally scrollable arguments and results.
acceptance: Provide a labeled wrap control for arguments and results.
Apply it across event changes; persist only the preference.
Copy and export exact sanitized text regardless of wrapping.
validation: Inspect long commands, URLs, JSON, and narrow layouts; compare copied text.

title: Add a grouped-by-tool exploration view
summary: Offer tool groups alongside the chronological timeline.
acceptance: Switch views while retaining original order within each tool group.
Show filtered group counts and keyboard-accessible expand controls.
Preserve event identity and details when switching views.
validation: Use interleaved tools and combined filters to verify counts, order, and selection.

title: Filter events by elapsed time range
summary: Focus investigation on a window when usable timestamps exist.
acceptance: Provide accessible start/end controls with inclusive boundaries.
Offer an explicit choice to include untimestamped events.
Explain unavailable ranges and reject invalid bounds.
validation: Check boundary events, absent times, reversed bounds, and combined filters.

title: Introduce a high-contrast viewer theme
summary: Provide a high-contrast preference for dense timelines and output.
acceptance: Add a labeled preference without storing session contents.
Meet 4.5:1 text and 3:1 control-boundary/focus contrast.
Retain non-color cues and usable controls in forced-colors mode.
validation: Measure contrast and inspect focused, selected, and failed states.

title: Add adjustable reading text size
summary: Allow larger interface and transcript text independently of browser zoom.
acceptance: Offer 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200% settings plus reset.
Keep controls, labels, and details usable without clipped text.
Persist only the preference and preserve native browser zoom.
validation: Review narrow/wide layouts at each size, including enlarged browser zoom.

title: Debounce accessible filter-result announcements
summary: Extend the existing live status region with concise filter announcements.
acceptance: Announce final matching counts after a debounce.
Cancel stale announcements when imports, clearing, or newer filters intervene.
Keep focus unchanged and exclude transcript text from announcements.
validation: Check rapid typing, zero results, importing, and clearing with a screen reader.

title: Navigate timeline events efficiently by keyboard
summary: Add navigation across incremental timeline batches.
acceptance: Support documented arrow and boundary keys within the event navigator.
Load the next batch when necessary and keep focus visible.
Choose predictable focus after filtering; ignore editable fields.
validation: Navigate several batches and filter out the focused event without a mouse.

title: Document a screen-reader review walkthrough
summary: Create a reproducible accessibility guide using sanitized fixtures.
acceptance: Cover import, filters, details, exports, errors, and clearing.
Document one screen-reader/browser pair and expected focus changes.
Include a versioned results template without claiming unperformed checks.
validation: Execute the walkthrough with the documented tools and attach actual results.

title: Test the keyboard-only review workflow
summary: Protect the main investigation workflow through visible browser controls.
acceptance: Add a development-only command covering import, filters, details, and clearing.
Assert focus and event selection beyond the first timeline batch.
Identify failed interactions; add no production runtime dependency.
validation: Run the suite and verify removing a required interaction causes failure.

title: Provide a single-column reading preference
summary: Let users request a linear reading layout on wide screens.
acceptance: Provide a documented single-column order for controls and content.
Preserve selection and focus without duplicate accessible controls.
Persist only the layout preference; support enlarged text.
validation: Switch layouts during keyboard review and repeat with 200% text.

title: Add an accessible structured JSON inspector
summary: Offer a navigable tree for sanitized objects and arrays.
acceptance: Implement tree navigation and correct expanded, level, and selection semantics.
Render keys/values safely; preserve payloads when switching to text.
Bound deep/large expansions and disclose fallback without silent data loss.
validation: Check nested arrays, nulls, hostile keys, and large payloads with assistive tools.

title: Introduce a deterministic comparison model
summary: Create a pure foundation for comparing normalized sanitized sessions.
acceptance: Return call, failure, and repeat counts with signed right-minus-left deltas.
Do not mutate inputs or classify unknown results as success/failure.
Handle empty sessions deterministically without timestamps.
validation: Test empty, identical, unequal, incomplete sessions and immutability.

title: Load two sessions into a comparison workspace
summary: Add labeled baseline and candidate imports with existing sanitization.
acceptance: Import both sides independently through parsing and redaction.
Keep the other session intact on failure and identify the failing side.
Label both sessions, allow replacement, and clear both on reset.
validation: Import valid/invalid files in both orders, replace one, and verify masking.

title: Show signed comparison summary metrics
summary: Present observed differences without unsupported quality judgments.
acceptance: Display baseline, candidate, and signed differences from the shared model.
State direction without treating every count decrease as improvement.
Render empty/identical sessions with textual equivalents for indicators.
validation: Compare known counts in both directions and reconcile displayed values.

title: Align tool-call sequences across sessions
summary: Expose matched and one-sided calls with deterministic bounded alignment.
acceptance: Use documented tool/input matching and preserve both call orders.
Break repeat ties deterministically; mark masked-input matches as ambiguous.
Enforce a work limit with an explicit fallback result.
validation: Test insertion, deletion, reordering, repeats, key order, masking, and limits.

title: Render an aligned comparison timeline
summary: Present corresponding calls with explicit one-sided gaps.
acceptance: Render matched, baseline-only, and candidate-only rows from the model.
Open correct details without mixing event identities between sessions.
Bound rendered rows and retain side labels on narrow screens.
validation: Review changed-call fixtures at narrow/wide sizes and across render batches.

title: Show differences between aligned tool results
summary: Add bounded line differences for sanitized aligned outputs.
acceptance: Mark unchanged, added, and removed lines using text and color.
Distinguish absent, empty, and identical results.
Render safe text and fall back explicitly when size limits are reached.
validation: Test repeated lines, trailing newlines, absent output, markup, and limit fallback.

title: Compare observed session time spans
summary: Compare timestamp-derived spans while exposing incomplete coverage.
acceptance: Use earliest and latest valid timestamps for observed spans.
Show coverage and withhold unsupported percentages or durations.
Avoid negative spans and claims about model compute time or cost.
validation: Check complete, partial, absent, out-of-order, and zero-span fixtures.

title: Compare per-tool call frequencies
summary: Show which tools account for differences in call counts.
acceptance: List both counts and signed differences for the union of tool names.
Use a shared bar scale and provide all values as text.
Sort deterministically, retain zero sides, and escape tool names.
validation: Compare overlapping/disjoint tools, ties, long names, and hostile labels.

title: Filter comparison rows by difference type
summary: Focus on added/removed calls, changed outputs, or changed status.
acceptance: Provide documented filters for one-sided calls and output/status changes.
Compute counts over the whole alignment, not only the rendered batch.
Reset restores alignment order and predictable selection.
validation: Combine difference types and verify counts and focus across batches.

title: Swap baseline and candidate sessions
summary: Reverse a comparison without reimporting local files.
acceptance: Add a labeled swap button without reimporting files.
Recompute signed differences and one-sided states.
Swapping twice restores the original and keeps focus on the control.
validation: Swap unequal sessions twice; check labels, signs, unmatched rows, and focus.

title: Export an offline HTML comparison report
summary: Produce a portable script-free comparison of sanitized sessions.
acceptance: Include labeled summaries, alignment rows, and bounded result differences.
Work offline without scripts or external assets under restrictive CSP.
Escape session text and disclose omitted oversized differences.
validation: Open offline; check hostile labels, missing times, empty sessions, and large diffs.

title: Export versioned comparison JSON
summary: Provide a documented artifact for reproducible comparison analysis.
acceptance: Document version, identifiers, metrics, and alignment references.
Resolve references against sanitized data without raw buffers/browser state.
Make unchanged inputs deterministic except documented optional export time.
validation: Parse exports independently; verify references, determinism, and redaction.

title: Chart event density in HTML reports
summary: Show timestamped activity concentration using bounded offline SVG.
acceptance: Assign valid times to equal-width bins with a bounded bar count.
Handle missing times and zero spans without inventing placement.
Provide SVG title/description and an equivalent count table.
validation: Verify boundaries, missing/equal times, totals, and offline CSP.

title: Visualize report tool-call frequencies
summary: Add an offline bar chart showing the most-used tools.
acceptance: Order counts deterministically with shared scale and numeric values.
Group excess tools as Other while preserving all counts in a table.
Escape labels and make the chart understandable without color.
validation: Check totals, ties, display limits, hostile labels, and no-call sessions.

title: Chart reported failures by tool name
summary: Show explicit failures and unresolved call states separately.
acceptance: Group failures by tool using documented normalized status semantics.
Count unknown/absent results separately from success.
Provide a zero-failure state and a script-free equivalent table.
validation: Reconcile success, failure, unresolved, and orphan-result fixture counts.

title: Visualize repeated-call positions in reports
summary: Show where repeat findings occur without requiring timestamps.
acceptance: Mark actual member calls in a sequence-position strip.
Preserve interleaved positions without claiming repetitions prove loops.
List positions as text and disclose display limits without altering totals.
validation: Check contiguous/interleaved repeats, multiple groups, missing times, and limits.

title: Expand long-report print regression coverage
summary: Extend basic print support for long payloads and reports across engines.
acceptance: Add a synthetic fixture with long outputs, wide tokens, and multiple pages.
Fix observed clipping/page breaks while preserving existing print support.
Document PDF checks in two engines with actual results and limitations.
validation: Generate PDFs in two engines; inspect long blocks and monochrome cues.

title: Add stable report navigation anchors
summary: Provide contents and finding-to-event links in long reports.
acceptance: Link major sections using unique deterministic anchors.
Link finding evidence to safe event-position identifiers.
Support descriptive links and offline fragments without scripts.
validation: Verify targets, unique IDs, and fragment navigation in exported files.

title: Export report charts as standalone SVG
summary: Reuse sanitized charts in documentation and issue discussions.
acceptance: Offer offline SVG downloads with viewBox and embedded styling.
Exclude scripts, external references, raw buffers, and unsafe labels.
Retain accessible titles without report scripts or CSP relaxation.
validation: Download under CSP, open SVGs, and inspect adversarial labels.

title: Visualize gaps between timestamped events
summary: Highlight observed event gaps without assigning unsupported causes.
acceptance: Compute gaps only between adjacent valid nondecreasing times.
Treat absent/backward times as unavailable intervals.
Show largest gaps in bounded SVG/table without claims about model latency.
validation: Test known gaps, ties, missing/backward times, and single-event sessions.

title: Analyze multiple explicitly named session files
summary: Generate separate reports for explicit paths without merging or discovering other logs.
acceptance: Create one report per named file without recursive discovery.
Give duplicate basenames stable unique names; do not change inputs.
Return nonzero for failures while retaining successful reports.
validation: Test two inputs, duplicate names, invalid input, and source hashes.

title: Handle closed output pipes without stack traces
summary: Handle downstream stdout closure while retaining unrelated output errors.
acceptance: Document a clean EPIPE exit policy.
Print neither stack traces nor session content on broken pipes.
Keep other output failures visible with nonzero status.
validation: Close a subprocess pipe early and separately inject a non-EPIPE error.

title: Expose machine-readable version information
summary: Let integrations identify package and Node versions without parsing prose.
acceptance: A --json version command returns package name/version and Node version.
Read version from package.json instead of duplicating it.
Exclude username, hostname, working directory, and environment.
validation: Parse subprocess output and compare package metadata.

title: Provide Bash and Zsh command completions
summary: Discover commands and options through local completions.
acceptance: Complete public commands, flags, and format values in both shells.
Never open or analyze session contents during completion.
Detect obsolete options with a consistency check.
validation: Run checks and shell recipes with spaced paths.

title: Add opt-in exit gates for diagnostic codes
summary: Fail CI on selected stable findings after successfully writing the report.
acceptance: Accept repeatable --fail-on codes from ABB-040.
Set documented status after successful report generation.
Reject unknown codes early; retain write-error precedence.
validation: Test matches, no match, multiple/unknown codes, and output errors.

title: Write reports atomically without replacing files
summary: Avoid partial output while preserving no-overwrite defaults and concurrent-write safety.
acceptance: Stage complete reports in the destination directory.
Atomic default publication never replaces an existing destination.
Failures/losing writers preserve existing bytes and remove staging files.
validation: Inject write failures and race two writers for one destination.

title: Add an explicit --force report-replacement option
summary: Allow deliberate report replacement while preserving safe default writes.
acceptance: Keep existing files protected unless --force is set.
Use completed staged output; failure preserves the old report.
Reject directories even with --force.
validation: Test absent/protected files, forced output, directories, and failed writes.

title: Support --output - for explicit stdout routing
summary: Name stdout as a destination for portable wrapper scripts.
acceptance: Route JSON and HTML to stdout with --output -.
Never create a file named - for this destination.
Keep status/error messages outside the report stream.
validation: Capture both formats and streams; inspect the working directory.

title: Add quiet mode for scheduled commands
summary: Suppress routine status messages while retaining reports and failures.
acceptance: --quiet suppresses routine success and startup messages.
Keep report bytes identical with and without the option.
Keep operational/argument errors visible and nonzero.
validation: Compare success, startup, missing-input, and invalid-argument streams.

title: Allow the local server to select an available port
summary: Support port zero through the CLI while retaining loopback-only binding.
acceptance: serve --port 0 requests an available OS port.
Print the actual bound localhost URL.
Support two concurrently reachable port-zero instances.
validation: Start two servers, request assets, and terminate both.

title: Bound shutdown with stale client connections
summary: Prevent incomplete HTTP requests from keeping interrupted servers alive.
acceptance: Exit within a documented grace period despite incomplete requests.
Close remaining sockets at deadline and release the port.
Keep no-client shutdown clean on supported platforms/signals.
validation: Hold partial-header sockets, signal the server, and enforce a timeout.

title: Add reviewed golden snapshots for CLI reports
summary: Catch output changes using small synthetic fixtures and narrow normalization.
acceptance: Snapshot JSON, HTML, and one documented failure.
Normalize only documented platform/path differences.
Require explicit snapshot updates outside ordinary tests.
validation: Run OS matrix and demonstrate a readable changed-field failure.

title: Provide a GitHub composite Action for analysis
summary: Analyze files already in an Actions workspace without uploading sessions/reports.
acceptance: Accept input, format, and output via safely passed arguments.
